wood_path.name: The Tollroad
wood_path.desc: The old road north, rutted and overgrown. Willows lean over it from both sides, dripping though it isn't raining. A guild waypost stands at the roadside, its lamp cold.

features.willows|trees: They weep sap the colour of tea. The wood was named for them long before the dark.
features.waypost|lamp: A guild waypost. Light it (type 'light') and it will burn on its own again, keeping Hollows away and letting you rest and refill here.

wood_fork.name: The Hanged Fork
wood_fork.desc: The road splits under a huge dead oak. Someone has nailed signs to it: WEST, CAMP. EAST, SHRINE. NORTH, DON'T. Old ropes hang from the lower branches, thankfully empty.

features.signs|oak: NORTH, DON'T has been carved over an older sign. The older one says MOTHER.

hunters_camp.name: Abandoned Hunters' Camp
hunters_camp.desc: Three tents, slashed and sagging. A cold firepit full of grey ash. Drying racks with nothing on them. Whatever happened here happened fast.

fixed.intro: One of the drying racks unfolds itself, stands up, and turns toward your light.

features.tents: Bedrolls, a boot, a child's carved wooden bird. You put the bird back.
features.firepit|ash: Cold for weeks. There are moth wings in the ash, hundreds of them.

thicket.name: Briar Thicket
thicket.desc: Thorns as long as fingers, woven into tunnels. The path winds through them toward a clearing where a second guild waypost stands, leaning.

features.thorns|briars: Something small came through here, and recently. There are threads caught on the thorns.
features.waypost: The second waypost. Its glass is cracked but the wick is good.

deepwood.name: The Deepwood
deepwood.desc: The trees close overhead. Even with your lantern the dark here feels thick, like water. To the west, a thread of real woodsmoke. To the east, a soft grey shimmer. To the north, the trees are white, and something enormous has broken a path through them.

features.path|white trees: The trunks are scored with antler marks higher than your head.

hermit_hut.name: Corvin's Hut
hermit_hut.desc: A crooked hut, half dug into a hillside, with a real fire burning in a real hearth. Bundles of herbs hang from the ceiling and a raven watches you from a perch. An old man in a coat of feathers squints at your lantern.

features.raven: It watches the lantern, not you.
features.herbs: Hemlock, feverfew, moonwort. And things you don't recognise.

moth_shrine.name: Shrine of the Moth
moth_shrine.desc: A mossy stone shrine to some forgotten saint of travellers, carved with moth wings. The third guild waypost stands beside it, smothered in grey moths.

fixed.intro: The moths on the waypost rise all at once, a grey cloud, and come for your lantern.

features.shrine|saint: The saint's face is worn away. Someone has left a honeycake as an offering. Old, but still good.
features.waypost: The third waypost. Light it and the whole Tollroad will be guarded again.

mother_grove.name: The White Grove
mother_grove.desc: A clearing of white birches around a pool as still as glass. Bones lie in heaps between the roots, picked clean. At the far side, a great cage of living roots has grown up from the earth.

features.pool: It reflects your lantern perfectly, but not you.
features.cage|roots: Woven roots, thick as your arm, grown into a dome.
